export-card-excel-no-disk-space: Waawaa yaltinde e Excel: boowal disk wellitaani
user-can-not-export-card-to-pdf: Kuutoro waawaa yaltinde kartal e PDF
user-can-not-export-card-to-excel: Kuutoro waawaa yaltinde kartal e Excel
filter-date-range-missing: Jey karte ɗe alaa ñalnde ndee
filter-date-range-invalid: Suɓo ñalɗe moƴƴe: ñalnde joofirde foti wonde ñalnde fuɗɗoode walla caggal mum.
filter-due-any: Ñalnde sakket kala (haa tee ɗe alaa ñalnde)
filter-column-age-disabled: Hoto suuɗ sabu juutugol e doggol
filter-column-age-hint: Suuɗ karte ɗe naati e doggol ngol ko ɓuri balɗe keewɗe hono ɗee ko ɓenni. Doggi goɗɗi e karte ɗe ñalɗe naatgol mum en anndaaka heddoto e yiyteede. Waylude kartal fuɗɗintaako sahaa mum e doggol kadi.
filter-on-desc: Aɗa siiwta karte e alluwal ngal. Dobo ɗoo ngam taƴtude siiwtorɗe.
advanced-filter-card-dates-hint: Siiwtu ñalɗe kartal e @createdAt, @receivedAt, @startAt, @dueAt, @endAt walla @listEnteredAt. Yeru: @endAt >= '2026-01-01' walla @endAt = none. Waɗ innde gesa keeriinga fuɗɗoriinga @ e nder maantore toɗɗugol.
advanced-filter-description: Siiwtorde ɓurnde yeeso yamirat winndude ɓoggol jogiingol waɗe ɗee: == != <= >= && || ( ) Boowal huutortee ko ceerndirgal hakkunde waɗe ɗee. A waawi siiwtaade galle keeriɗe fof so a winndii inɗe mum e kiisol mum. Yeru: Field1 == Value1. Tesko: So galle walla kiisol ngoodi boowal, a foti uddude ɗe e limle teelɗe. Yeru: 'Field 1' == 'Value 1'. Ngam diwde alkule ɗe kuutoragol ɗe gootal (' /), a waawi huutoraade \. Yeru: Field1 == I'm. A waawi kadi renndinde sarɗiiji keewɗi. Yeru: F1 == V1 || F1 == V2. E laawol goowangol, waɗe fof paamate iwde nano yahde ñaamo. A waawi waylude lommbol ngol so a waɗii ƴoƴƴe. Yeru: F1 == V1 && ( F2 == V2 || F2 == V3 ). A waawi kadi yiylaade galle binndol e regex: F1 == /Tes.*/i
text-contains-trigger-description: Waɗi ɗuum tuma kaatoo winndaa, walla tiitoonde walla fillayle mum waylaa, e winndannde hesere ndee woni e ɗuum (alaa fii mawɗe walla pamare winndannde).
imported-member-no-account: Tergal naatnaangal — alaa tawo konte jaaɓduɗe
import-board-instruction-kanboard: Ɗakku JSON yaltinaaɗo e Kanboard: geɗel jogiingel "columns" (walla golle jogiiɗe column_name) e doggol "tasks" (title, description, column_name, swimlane_name, date_due, owner, tags). Columns maa ngonta doggi, tee tasks maa ngonta karte.
import-board-instruction-deck: Ɗakku JSON alluwal NextCloud Deck (alluwal jogiingal "stacks", kala stack jogii "cards" mum). Stacks maa ngonta doggi, tee cards maa ngonta karte.
import-board-instruction-openproject: Ɗakku JSON renndo work-packages OpenProject (GET /api/v3/work_packages). Statuses maa ngonta doggi, tee work packages maa ngonta karte.
import-board-instruction-issues: Ɗakku doggol JSON caɗeele __sourceName__ (__endpoint__). Caɗeele maa ngonta karte renndinaaɗe e doggi Udditii / Uddataama.
import-board-instruction-asana: Ɗakku JSON yaltinal golle Asana ({ "data": [...] } iwde e yaltinal Asana walla GET /tasks). Golle renndintee e taƴe (memberships); golle timmuɗe njahata to Timmii.
import-board-instruction-zenkit: Ɗakku JSON yaltinal doggol ZenKit ({ "title", "stages":[...], "items":[...] }). Stages maa ngonta doggi, tee items maa ngonta karte.
import-board-instruction-markdown: Habbir happirde golle markdown (aada nde kaɓirɗe markdown-kanban wano Obsidian Kanban huutortoo): tiitooje "## Innde lislub", e kuutorɗe "- [ ]"/"- [x]" e ley. Tiitooje ɗen wonata lislub, kuutorɗe ɗen wonata kaarte; lislub e tolli ngu alaa checkbox kadi naatirta, wano kaarte uddaaɗe.
import-board-instruction-leo: Ɗakku mbaadi Leo (fiilde .leo). Taƴe gonɗe e dow fof ngontata doggi, taƴe les mum en ɗoon ngontata karte, binndol taƴre ndee wonata sifaa kartal ngal. Taƴe ɓurɗe luggaade ngontata doggi ƴeewndagol. Taƴe maantaaɗe naatnete no golle timmuɗe.
import-board-instruction-opml: Ɓortu daɗɗol OPML, no Workflowy, Dynalist, OmniOutliner, Logseq e kuutorɗe goɗɗe njaltinirta ɗum. Huunde dow ina ngonta doggi, ɓiɗɓe mum ina ngonta karte, yowre ndee wonta cifagol, tee huunde ɓurnde lugginde ina ngonta doggi ƴeewndagol. Huunde timmunde ina naatna no timmuɗe.
import-board-instruction-orgmode: Ɓortu fiilde Org mode, no Emacs, Orgzly walla Beorg mbinndirta ɗum. Tiitoonde dow ina ngonta doggi tee tiitoonde ɗiɗaɓe ina ngonta karte. TODO e DONE, adanorɗe, maantorɗe, SCHEDULED, DEADLINE e CLOSED ina ndeenee, tee kaɓirɗe ƴeewtagol e tiitoonde ɓurnde lugginde ina ngonta doggi ƴeewndagol.
import-board-instruction-todotxt: Ɗakku fiilde todo.txt: golle goote e kala gorol, no jaaɓnirgal todo.txt e jaaɓnirɗe jahduɗe mbinndirta ɗum. Golle timmuɗe ("x") njaha to Gasii, +project e @context mbaylitoo maantore, (A) waylitoo maantore arande, due: e t: mbaylitoo ñalɗi duttal e fuɗɗoode.
import-board-instruction-taskwarrior: Ɗakku njaltudi task export: doggol JSON, walla golle gootel e kala gorol. Golle timmuɗe njaha to Done, project e priority ngonta maandeeji, annotations wontata yowe, tee depends wontata jokkondire e golle ɗe ngaddata faddoore.
import-board-instruction-focalboard: Uddit fiilde .boardarchive tee ɗakku board.jsonl alluwal ngal, wondude e gorol yamre mum walla tawa alaa ngol. Sifa renndinde e gurupu e yiyngo alluwal wontata doggi, sifaaji cuɓagol goɗɗi ngonta maandeeji, taƴe binndi e kaɓirɗe maantagol ngonta sifaa e doggol ƴeewndagol, tee yowe danndetee. Nate e ɓeyditte naatnetaake.
import-board-instruction-todoist: In Todoist, open the project menu and choose Export as a template, then paste the CSV file. Sections become lists, tasks become cards, sub-tasks become a checklist, notes become comments, and @labels and priorities p1 to p3 become labels.
import-board-instruction-planner: In Microsoft Planner, open the plan's menu and choose Export plan to Excel, then choose that .xlsx file. Buckets become lists and tasks become cards, with their assignees, dates, labels, checklist and description; Progress, Priority and Completed By become custom fields.
import-board-instruction-meistertask: E MeisterTask, dobo innde porose, suɓo Export project tee yaltin CSV, refti ɓortu ɗum. Pecce ina ngonta doggi tee golle ina ngonta karte, e yowe mum en, ñalngu timmugol, halfinaaɗo e maantorɗe; golle timmuɗe ina ndeena ñalngu timmugol mum. CSV winndaaɗo ngam naatnugol MeisterTask kadi ina gollira.
import-board-instruction-obsidian: E Obsidian, uddit fiilde alluwal Kanban no Markdown (walla uddit fiilde .md e taƴtorde binndi), refti ɓortu ɗum fof. Laabi ina ngonta doggi e keerol karte mum en, karte ina ndeena maantorɗe mum en, ñalɗi, adanorde, galle e doggol ƴeewndagol, tee Mooftirde ndee wonta karte egginaaɗe e mooftirde.
import-board-instruction-linear: E Linear, yaltin caɗeele ɗee no CSV (Settings, Import / Export, Export data, walla yaltingol jiytol), refti ɓortu CSV oo. Ngonkaaji ina ngonta doggi, ekipuuji ina ngonta laabi, tee caɗeele ina ngonta karte e halfinaaɗo mum, maantorɗe, ñalɗi, caɗeele daddo, adanorde, kiisol, porose e cakkol.
import-board-instruction-ticktick: E TickTick, uddit Settings, Account, Backup & Import tee sos reenaande, refti ɓortu fiilde CSV ndee. Kala doggol TickTick ina wonta laawol tee kolonji mum ina ngonta doggi; golle ina ndeena maantorɗe mum en, ñalɗi, doggol ƴeewndagol, adanorde e golle pamaroore.
import-board-instruction-clickup: E ClickUp, yaltin golle ɗee no CSV (Settings, Imports / Exports, Export Items, walla yaltingol jiytol List walla Table e kolonji fof), refti ɓortu CSV oo. Ngonkaaji ina ngonta doggi, doggi ClickUp ina ngonta laabi, tee golle ina ngonta karte e golle pamaroore mum, halfinaaɓe, maantorɗe, ñalɗi, adanorde e sahaa.
import-board-instruction-nullboard: E Nullboard, uddit alluwal ngal, suɓo Export this board... e dosol ngol, uddit fiilde .nbx ndee e taƴtorde binndi tee ɓortu ko woni e mum. Doggi ina ngonta doggi tee yowe ina ngonta karte: diidol aranol yowre ko innde kartal, tee ko heddii ko cifagol mum. Yowre raw ina heɓa maantorol raw. Fiilde jogiinde alluuje keewɗe ina naatna alluwal mum aranal.
import-board-instruction-kanri: E Kanri, uddit Import & Export tee suɓo Export individual board (walla Export all data), refti ɓortu fiilde .json ndee. Kolonji ina ngonta doggi tee karte ina ngonta karte, e cifagol mum, ñalngu timmugol, maantorɗe e gooɓi; golle kartal ina ngonta doggol ƴeewndagol. E yaltingol keɓe fof, alluwal aranal ngal naatnetee.
import-board-instruction-planka: Winndu ñiiɓirde Planka maa (ko wayi no https://planka.example.com), innde kuutorɗo Planka maa e finnde suuraande, refti ñoƴƴu Limto. Ɗum huutortee tan ngam heɓde alluwal ngal, wonaa mooftaade. Suɓo alluwal ñoƴƴaa Heɓ: WeKan janngat ngal e API Planka, e doggi mum, kartalle, sifaaji, ñalɗi sakket, maandeeji, terɗe, doggi golle e yowe; refti jokku naatnugol no woowi. Kartalle ngonɗe e mooftirde Planka naatnete mooftaaɗe; ɓeyditte e kartalle ngonɗe e boowal ɓuuɓɗal naatnaaka.
import-board-instruction-mstodo: E Microsoft Graph Explorer (developer.microsoft.com/graph/graph-explorer), seŋo, jaɓ jamirol Tasks.Read refti natto token ngon e tab Access token. Ɓattin ɗoo ñoƴƴaa Limto; token ngon huutortee tan ngam heɓgol ngol, mooftaaka. Suɓo doggi fof walla gootol ñoƴƴaa Heɓ. Kala doggol To Do wonta doggol, kala golle wonta kartal, e binndi mum, ñalɗi sakket e fuɗɗo, daawe hono doggol ƴeewndagol, fannuuji hono maandeeji, e teeŋtingol mawngol e ngonka hono maandeeji; golle timmuɗe mooftete. Siftorɗe e ruttinoyɗe naatnaaka.
import-board-instruction-kanbanflow: E KanbanFlow, uddit cuɓirgal alluwal ngal, suɓo Settings → API & Webhooks refti natto token API alluwal ngal. Ɓattin token ngon ɗoo, ñoƴƴu Limto, suɓo alluwal ngal ñoƴƴaa Heɓ; token ngon huutortee tan ngam heɓgol ngol, mooftaaka. Kolonnaaji ngonta doggi, laabi ngoni laabi; golle ndeenat sifaa mum, goobu, maandeeji, ñalnde sakket, golle cukaletti hono doggol ƴeewndagol, waktu huutoraaɗo, hiisa, yimɓe e yowe.
import-board-instruction-basecamp: Winndu ID konte Basecamp maa (limre ndee ɓaawo basecamp.com/ e ñiiɓirde ndee) e token naatirgal (iwde e jaaɓnirgal OAuth 2 winndaangal e launchpad.37signals.com, walla ngal jokkondiral woodoowal jogii), ñoƴƴu Limto, suɓo eɓɓoore ñoƴƴaa Heɓ. Token ngon huutortee tan ngam heɓgol ngol, mooftaaka. Kala taabal kartalle wonta laawol e kolonnaaji mum hono doggi, doggi golle ngonta laawol Golle; kartalle e golle ndeenat binndol mum, ñalɗi, yimɓe halfinaaɓe e yowe, daawe kartal ngonta doggol ƴeewndagol, golle timmuɗe mooftete.
import-board-instruction-googletasks: Heɓ token naatirgal e OAuth 2.0 Playground: les Tasks API v1 suɓo tasks.readonly, ñoƴƴu Authorize APIs, refti Exchange authorization code for tokens, natto token naatirgal ngon. Ɓattin ɗoo ñoƴƴaa Limto, suɓo doggi golle fof walla gootol, refti Heɓ. Token ngon huutortee tan ngam heɓgol ngol, mooftaaka. Doggi golle ngonta doggi, golle ngonta kartalle, e binndi mum, jokkorɗe e ñalnde sakket; golle cukaletti ngonta doggol ƴeewndagol, golle timmuɗe naatnete mooftaaɗe.
import-board-instruction-googlekeep: API Google Keep ko konte Google Workspace tan. Heɓ token naatirgal OAuth 2.0 e jaajeende https://www.googleapis.com/auth/keep.readonly (e OAuth 2.0 Playground so ardiiɗo Workspace maa yamirii, walla iwde e konte carwol jogiingol neldugol e leydi fof), ɓattin ngon, ñoƴƴu Limto refti Heɓ. Token ngon huutortee tan ngam heɓgol ngol, mooftaaka. Binndi bindi ngonta kartalle e doggol Binndi, binndi doggol ƴeewndagol ngonta kartalle e doggol Doggi e geɗe mum hono doggol ƴeewndagol. Binndi ngonɗi e boowal ɓuuɓɗal, ɓeyditte e lollingol naatnaaka.
api-import-desc: Heɓ ɗum e carwol ngol e konte maa hoore. Ko winndataa ɗoo huutortee tan ngam heɓgol ngol, mooftaaka.
api-import-fetched: Heɓaama. Ƴeew terɗe les ɗee naatnaa.
api-import-nothing: Alaa ko naatnetee e ndee konte.
import-board-instruction-pivotal: E Pivotal Tracker, uddit tabbere MORE porose ndee tee suɓo Export CSV (walla suɓo daarti tee suɓo Bulk Actions, CSV), refti ɓortu CSV oo. Kala ngonka daarti ina wonta doggol tee daarti ina ngonta karte, e mbaydi mum e maantorɗe, jom mum en, ɗaɓɓiiɗo, ñalɗi, yowe, golle e haɗooji; Estimate ina wonta Story points tee iterations ina ngonta sprints.
import-board-instruction-tasksorg: E Tasks.org, uddit Settings, Backups tee suɓo Export tasks, refti ɓortu ko woni e fiilde .json ndee. Doggi ina ngonta doggi tee golle ina ngonta karte, e yowe mum en, maantorɗe, ñalɗi, yowe e golle pamaroore; golle timmuɗe ina ndeena ñalngu timmugol mum, tee adanorde ina wonta gallol keeriingol.
import-board-instruction-monday: E monday.com, uddit dosol alluwal ngal, suɓo More actions e Export board to Excel (e kesɗitine e subitems so a yiɗii), refti suɓo fiilde .xlsx ndee. Kolon Status ina wonta doggi tee fedde ina ngonta laabi; yimɓe, ñalɗi, layluure sahaa e maantorɗe ina ndeena nokkuuji mum en, kolonji goɗɗi ina ngonta galle keeriɗe tee kesɗitine ina ngonta yowe.
import-board-instruction-superproductivi: E Super Productivity, uddit Settings, refti Sync & Backup, suɓo Export Data tee ɓortu ko woni e fiilde sp-backup .json ndee. Kala porose ina wonta laawol tee golle ina ngonta karte e To Do, In Progress, Backlog walla Done, e yowe mum en, maantorɗe, ñalngu timmugol, sahaa huuwiraaɗo e golle pamaroore; golle egginaaɗe e mooftirde ina ngonta karte egginaaɗe e mooftirde.
import-board-instruction-taiga: E Taiga, uddit Admin > Project > Export tee aawto dump porose oo (fuɗɗo firtude fiilde .json.gz), refti ɓortu JSON mum. Ngonkaaji user story ina ngonta doggi, user stories ina ngonta karte e golle mum en no golle pamaroore, epics e caɗeele ina keɓa laabi mum en, tee sprints, maantorɗe, yowe e jeyi keeriiɗi ina ngara kadi. Ceŋaaɗi naatnataake.
import-board-instruction-vikunja: E Vikunja, uddit Settings, suɓo Data Export tee aawto fiilde .zip nde neldetee maa, refti suɓo fiilde ndee, walla ɓortu data.json gonɗo e mum. Baageeji Kanban ina ngonta doggi tee golle ina ngonta karte, e maantorɗe mum en, halfinaaɓe, ñalɗi, cifagol, doggi golle no doggi ƴeewndagol e yowe; adanorde, keeri timmugol e timmugol ina ngonta galle keeriɗe. Ceŋaaɗi naatnataake.
import-board-instruction-quire: E Quire, uddit dosol porose tee suɓo Export CSV, refti ɓortu CSV oo. Ngonkaaji ina ngonta doggi tee golle ina ngonta karte, e golle pamaroore mum en no karte ɓiɗɗe, halfinaaɓe, maantorɗe no maantorɗe, ñalɗi fuɗɗoode, timmugol e timminaa, cifagol e adanorde no gallol keeriingol. Yowe e ceŋaaɗi ngalaa e CSV Quire.
import-board-instruction-wrike: E Wrike, yaltin porose walla dosiyee e Excel, walla hebbin mbaydi naatnugol Excel Wrike, refti suɓo fiilde .xlsx ndee. Diidi dosiyee e porose ina ngonta laabi, Status ina wonta doggi tee golle ina ngonta karte, e Key mum, gollal daddo, halfinaaɓe, ñalɗi fuɗɗoode e timmoode, jokkondire e cifagol; Priority, Duration e kolonji goɗɗi ina ngonta galle keeriɗe.
import-board-instruction-teamwork: E Teamwork.com, hebbin mbaydi naatnugol golle Excel (Tasklist, Task, Description, Assign to, Start date, Due date, Priority, Estimated time, Tags, Status) tee reen ɗum no .xlsx, refti suɓo fiilde ndee. Doggi golle ina ngonta doggi tee golle ina ngonta karte; gollal fuɗɗiingal e -, # walla > ina wonta gollel gollal dow mum (--, ## walla >> ina ɓura lugginde darnde gootal). Halfinaaɓe, ñalɗi e maantorɗe ina ndeena nokkuuji mum en; Priority, Estimated time e Complete ina ngonta galle keeriɗe.
import-board-instruction-businessmap: E Businessmap (ko adii Kanbanize), uddit Advanced Search, suɓo Configure results ngam suɓaade kolonji, aawto fiilde Excel ndee, refti suɓo fiilde .xlsx ndee. Kolonji ina njanngee e inɗe mum en Engeleere (Title, Column, Lane, Owner, Deadline ...): so konte maa ina huutoroo ɗemngal goɗngal, wayl inɗe diidol tiitoonde ngol e Engeleere tawo. Column ina wonta doggi tee Lane laabi; jom mum en, maantorɗe, goobu, ñalɗi, yowe e jokkole daddo ina ndeena nokkuuji mum en, tee Priority, Size, Type e kolonji goɗɗi ina ngonta galle keeriɗe.
import-board-instruction-redmine: E Redmine, uddit Issues porose ndee, suɓo Also available in: CSV les doggol ngol, suɓo kolonji (All columns, e Description) tee yaltin, refti ɓortu CSV oo. Redmine ina inna kolonji e ɗemngal maa, njuu teel ɗemngal maa e Engeleere e My account hade yaltinde. Kala ngonka ina wonta doggol tee caɗeele ina ngonta karte, e tracker no maantorol, halfinaaɗo, binnduɗo, ñalɗi, gollal daddo e caɗeele jokkondirɗe; adanorde, fedde, yamre faandaare, sahaa hiisaaɗo, % Done e galle keeriɗe ina ngonta galle keeriɗe.
import-board-instruction-notion: E Notion, uddit dowdi keɓe ndee no hello timmungo, suɓo ••• e Export, suɓo Markdown & CSV, tee suɓo fiilde .zip nde aawtetee, walla CSV dowdi keɓe gooto e mum, walla ɓortu CSV oo. Kolon innaaɗo Status ina wonta doggi (so alaa, kolon aranol nanndungol e suɓagol ina waɗa ɗum, tee jaŋtol naatnugol ngol ina wiya hol ngol); diidi ina ngonta karte e innde mum, maantorɗe no maantorɗe, yimɓe no terɗe, ñalɗi, e binndi hello ngoo no cifagol; kolonji goɗɗi ina ngonta galle keeriɗe. Jokkondire, nate e ceŋaaɗi naatnataake.
import-board-instruction-plane: E Plane, uddit Workspace Settings, suɓo Exports, yaltin porose ɗee no JSON, CSV walla Excel tee aawto fiilde .zip ndee, refti suɓo fiilde ndee, walla fiilde gootol gonɗo e mum, walla ɓortu JSON walla CSV oo. Ngonkaaji ina ngonta doggi, porose ina ngonta laabi, tee caɗeele ina ngonta karte e innitorde mum, daddo, halfinaaɓe, maantorɗe, ñalɗi, jokkole e yowe; adanorde, kiisol, cakkol e moodil ina ngonta galle keeriɗe. Yaltingol Plane alaa cifagol walla ceŋaaɗi, ɗum noon naatnataake.
import-board-instruction-trello: E alluwal Trello maa, yahu to 'Menu', rewtu 'More', 'Print and Export', 'Export JSON', kisa natto binndol keɓaangol.
import-board-instruction-csv: Ɗakku Kiisol Ceŋondiral (CSV) / Kiisol Tab (TSV) maa.
import-board-instruction-jira: Ɗakku JSON iwɗo e njiilaw caɗeele Jira Cloud REST API (GET /rest/api/3/search/jql), walla geɗel nanndungel { "issues": [...] }. Jira statuses maa ngonta doggi, tee issues maa ngonta karte. A waawi ɓeydude doggol "automationRules" ngam naatnude kuule.
import-board-instruction-excel: Suɓo haayre .xlsx mbaydi WeKan (galle ɗe yaltinal Excel: Title, Description, Status/List, Members, Labels, dates, custom fields). Gorol aranol ko hoore.
import-board-instruction-wekan: E alluwal maa, yahu to 'Menu', rewtu 'Export board', kisa natto binndol nder fiilde aawtaande ndee.

globalSearch-instructions-operator-due: `__operator_due__:<n>` - karte ɗe keerol mum woni haa balɗe *<n>* iwde e jooni. `__operator_due__:__predicate_overdue__ limtata karte fof yawtiiɗe ñalngu keerol mum.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-creat: `__operator_created__:<n>` - karte sosaaɗe balɗe *<n>* ɓennuɗe walla ko jaasi
globalSearch-instructions-operator-modif: `__operator_modified__:<n>` - karte waylaaɗe balɗe *<n>* ɓennuɗe walla ko jaasi
globalSearch-instructions-status-all: `__predicate_all__` - karte mooftaaɗe e ɗe mooftaaka fof
globalSearch-instructions-operator-has: `__operator_has__:<field>` - ɗo *<field>* woni gooto e `__predicate_attachment__`, `__predicate_checklist__`, `__predicate_description__`, `__predicate_start__`, `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_end__`, `__predicate_assignee__` walla `__predicate_member__`. Waɗde `-` yeeso *<field>* yiylata alaa kiisol e gallal ngal (yeru `has:-due` yiylata karte ɗe ngalaa ñalngu keerol).
globalSearch-instructions-operator-sort: `__operator_sort__:<sort-name>` - ɗo *<sort-name>* woni gooto e `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_created__` walla `__predicate_modified__`. Ngam deggondiral jippoowal, waɗ `-` yeeso innde deggondiral.
globalSearch-instructions-operator-limit: `__operator_limit__:<n>` - ɗo *<n>* woni limoore timmunde ɓeyditte kolliroore limooje karte e kala hello.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-2:
Waɗe nannduɗe njokketee e *OR*. Karte jaaɗɗe e sarɗol kala maa ngartine.
`__operator_list__:Available __operator_list__:Blocked` maa wartin karte gonɗe e doggol kala innde mum *Blocked* walla *Available*.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3: Waɗe ceertuɗe njokketee e *AND*. Karte jaaɗɗe e waɗe ceertuɗe fof tan ngartintee. `__operator_list__:Available __operator_label__:red` wartinata tan karte e doggol *Available* jogiiɗe maantorol *red*.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3-2: Balɗe mbaawi joopteede hono limoore timmunde ɓeyditte walla ustite, walla huutoraade `__predicate_week__`, `__predicate_month__`, `__predicate_quarter__` walla `__predicate_year__` ngam sahaa gonɗo.

attachment-repair-locations-description: Yiytu ceŋaaɗi e nate kuutorooɓe ɗe mooftorde mum winnditaande (fiilde-sistem / GridFS / duule) jaaɗataa e nokku fiilde ndee woni, tee moƴƴin ruttorde keɓe ngam hollitde nokkuure goonga.

mongodb-compact-description: Caggal dirtinde piille iwde e MongoDB GridFS, fiilde ruttorde keɓe e disk ustataako e jaajol. Hurmingol Compact ruttinta boowal rimɗingal so winnditii keɓe renndo. Hurmin ɗum tan caggal dirtinol piille keewɗe timmii.
mongodb-compact-warning: Reentino: Compact ko golle haɓoore nde waawi juutude hojomaaji keewɗi e ruttorɗe keɓe mawɗe. E pelle replika, ɓallooɓe fof compactetee tawo (e jaajol), kisa arano. E pelle replika nod gooto kuutorteeɗe ngam oplog (teelte Meteor goowɗe), arano tan compactetee.

database-migration-description: Eggit keɓe binndol (fof so wonaa ceŋaaɗi e nate kuutorooɓe, ɗe keddata e fiilde-sistem) hakkunde MongoDB e FerretDB v1 (SQLite). Ruttorde keɓe woɗnde ndee foti dogde tee heɓotoo (poorɗe goowɗe: FerretDB mongodb://127.0.0.1:27018, MongoDB mongodb://127.0.0.1:27019; waylu e WEKAN_FERRETDB_URL / WEKAN_MONGODB_URL). Caggal nde timmii, hollit MONGO_URL to ruttorde keɓe woɗnde tee hurmin WeKan kadi (e Snap: snap set wekan database=ferretdb walla =mongodb).
database-migrate-to-ferretdb: Eggit keɓe binndol to FerretDB v1 (SQLite)
database-migration-confirm: Natto renndorɗe keɓe binndol fof to __db__? Ceŋaaɗi e nate kuutorooɓe e fiilde-sistem meemataako. Ruttorde keɓe tiŋorde ndee foti dogde.
sandstorm-migration-description: So WeKan ina doga nder grain Sandstorm, ruttorde keɓe MongoDB 3 nayeejo mum eggittee to FerretDB v1 (SQLite) e hurmingol aranol, tee ceŋaaɗi e nate kuutorooɓe dirtinee iwde e ruttorde keɓe to deftirɗe files/attachments e files/avatars grain oo. Ɗum hollata so eggitugol ngol moƴƴii e ko honno boowal disk piille ruttorde keɓe MongoDB kesɗe ɗee kuutortoo tawo nder grain oo, tee yamir-ma momtude piille kesɗe ɗee ngam rimɗinde boowal.
sandstorm-delete-raw-mongodb: Momtu piille ruttorde keɓe MongoDB kesɗe
sandstorm-delete-raw-mongodb-description: Caggal eggitugol moƴƴungol keɓe ɗee ngoni e FerretDB e fiilde-sistem, wadde piille ruttorde keɓe MongoDB 3 kesɗe nayeeje ɗee mbaawi momteede ngam rimɗinde boowal disk grain. Ɗum waawaa firteede.
sandstorm-delete-raw-mongodb-confirm: Momtu piille ruttorde keɓe MongoDB 3 kesɗe ngam rimɗinde boowal disk? Keɓe ɗee eggitaama tawo to FerretDB e fiilde-sistem. Ɗum waawaa firteede.
sandstorm-raw-mongodb-deleted: Piille ruttorde keɓe MongoDB kesɗe momtaama, boowal rimɗinaama
features-desc: Baawɗe cuɓotooɗe ɗe WeKan oo hokki. Baawal ngal maandaaka ina suuɗee e jiytol kuutortooɓe fof. Keɓe maggal ina mooftaa, jamirooje mbaylataake.
feature-views-table-desc: Alluwal ngal hono haɓɓere kartaleeje baawɗe yuɓɓineede.
feature-views-overview-desc: Limooje, renndo e kuutortooɗo ɗo golle jonnaa, eɓɓoore laawol, alluwal jiytol e alluwal mawngal.
feature-views-scrum-desc: Doggol golle dewɗe ciiftorgal, duuɗe golle cakkitiiɗe, jaŋtol duunde e jaawgol golle.
feature-views-flow-charts-desc: Ustugol golle keddiiɗe, ɓeydugol golle timmuɗe, doggol golle renndingol, waktu iwde e fuɗɗoode haa timmugol e iwde e ñaagol haa timmugol, golle timmuɗe e sahaa gooto, waktu ɓennguɗo e golle ɗe timmaani, paddorɗe, Monte Carlo e ɓetirɗe goɗɗe doggol golle.
feature-views-map-desc: Kartaleeje hono maantorɗe e natal yollitaaɗo.
feature-approval-required: Accu baawɗe ɓeydaaɗe e kesɗitine WeKan ɗe ñifaa haa jiiloowo hurmina ɗe
feature-preview-admins: Jiilooɓe ina njiya baawɗe ñifaaɗe, ngam ƴeewtaade ɗe adii hay gooto
feature-pilot-users: Kuutortooɓe ƴeewtotooɓe, ɓe njiya kadi baawɗe ñifaaɗe
card-field-visibility-desc: Galle Teelte Alluwal / Kartal ɗe alluuje mbaawi hollude. Gallol ngol maantaaka ina suuɗaa e kala kartal, kartal pamarel e Teelte Alluwal / Kartal kala alluwal. Hay keɓal kartal walla teeltol alluwal waylataake, tee maantude ngol kadi ina hollita kala alluwal no ngal teelirnoo. Doosgol galle ko kala alluwal jeyi.
cards-loading-auto: E jaajol (loowgol seeɗa tan ngam alluuje mawɗe)
cards-loading-description: WeKan loowata karte alluwal e jaajol: alluwal mawngal (ɓurŋgal keerol mawneendi) loowata karte jiyotooɗe jooni tan (wuufugol ngalaa keerol) e limoore wurmunde, ngam ngal heddoo yaawi tee huutora tesko e bandwidth seeɗa, tawi alluuje pamare loowata kartal kala ngam kuutoragol ɓurɗol weeɓde e baawɗe timmuɗe. Alaa ko teeltee. Jiilooɓe ina mbaawi doolnude mbaydi e baylitte taariindi CARDS_LOADING (all/lazy/auto) e CARDS_LOADING_LAZY_THRESHOLD.
cards-loading-lazy-note: Loowgol karte seeɗa ko ƴeewndol: limtorɗe karte e keeri WIP ina moƴƴi, kono jiytol Haatumeere/Haɓɓere/Gantt e cuɓagol keewɗe kollata karte loowaaɗe haa jooni tan. Loowtu alluuje udditiiɗe caggal waylude ɗum.
render-links-as-plain-text-description: So hurminaama, jokke fof (jokke markdown hono [label](url) e tage HTML kesɗe <a href>) kollirtee sahaa kala hono binndol mehre ɗe ndobotaako e kala gallal binndol ƴellitiingol (inɗe alluwal e kartal, cifagol, jowe, doggi ƴeewtagol, ekn.). Ɗum haɗata jokke maajnooje ɗe ndobotoo. E goowangol ɗum dartii, wadde jokke keddata ko ndobotooɗe.
always-show-code-as-text: Hollu kod fof hono binndol mehre sahaa kala
always-show-code-as-text-description: So hurminaama, binndol ƴellitiingol hollirtaake hono markdown walla HTML: iwdi fof hollirtee sahaa kala hono binndol mehre e kala gallal binndol ƴellitiingol (inɗe alluwal e kartal, cifagol, jowe, doggi ƴeewtagol, ekn.). Ɗum feeŋtinta loowdi suuɗiindi — jowe HTML (<!-- -->), tiŋorde jokke markdown, JavaScript e kod goɗɗo kala — wadde kod fof jiyoto sahaa kala, ndobotaako, tee dogaali. E goowangol ɗum dartii, wadde markdown hollirtee no haanirta.
disable-all-import-description: So hurminaama, baawɗe naatnugol fof dartinte: naatnugol alluwal iwde e WeKan JSON, Trello, CSV/Excel, Jira, Kanboard, NextCloud Deck, OpenProject, GitHub, GitLab, Gitea e Forgejo, e kadi sowtinde alluwal. Cuɓe dosol naatnugol cuuɗetee tee sarworde sala ñaagol naatnugol kala. E goowangol ɗum dartii.
disable-all-export-description: So hurminaama, baawɗe yaltinugol fof dartinte: yaltinugol alluwal hono WeKan JSON, CSV, Excel, Kanboard, walla to NextCloud Deck / OpenProject / GitHub / GitLab / Gitea / Forgejo, e yaltinugol ceŋaagal gootol. Cuɓe dosol yaltinugol cuuɗetee tee sarworde sala ñaagol yaltinugol kala. E goowangol ɗum dartii.
disable-import-avatars-description: So hurminaama, nate kuutorooɓe (nate profil kuutoro) naatnataake sahaa kala. Ɗum huɓi naatnugol WeKan JSON, naatnugol Trello, e jahdingol nate iwde e carwinooɓe goongɗitingol yaasi nde ceŋetee (LDAP, OIDC/OAuth2). Inɗe e keɓe goɗɗe naatnetee tawo; nate kuutorooɓe tan ndiwetee. E goowangol ɗum dartii.
disable-export-avatars-description: So hurminaama, nate kuutorooɓe (nate profil kuutoro) naatnataa sahaa kala nder yaltinal alluwal (yaltinal WeKan JSON e CSV). Inɗe kuutorooɓe e keɓe goɗɗe yaltintee tawo; nate tan njoppee. E goowangol ɗum dartii.
anonymize-import-users-description: So hurminaama, naatnugol alluwal WeKan JSON lommbata innde kuutoro, innde timmunde e alkule arane kala kuutoro naatnaaɗo e lommbirɗe limtorɗe (user1, user2, ...), yoppita natal mum, tee winndita yettagol @username (e galle requested-by / assigned-by) nder loowdi kartal e yowre naatnaande. Innde goonga kuutoro iwde e alluwal iwdi mooftataake. Helmere "kuutoro" jokkat ɗemngal neɗɗo naatnoowo. E goowangol ɗum dartii.
anonymize-export-users-description: So hurminaama, yaltinugol alluwal lommbata innde kuutoro, innde timmunde e alkule arane kala kuutoro yaltinaaɗo e lommbirɗe limtorɗe (user1, user2, ...), yoppita natal mum, tee winndita yettagol @username (e galle requested-by / assigned-by) nder loowdi kartal e yowre. Fiilde yaltinaande ndee jogotaako innde goonga kuutoro. Helmere "kuutoro" jokkat ɗemngal neɗɗo yaltinoowo. E goowangol ɗum dartii.
anonymize-account-confirm-popup: So hurminaama, yaltinugol alluwal lommbata innde kuutoro, innde timmunde e alkule arane kala kuutoro yaltinaaɗo e lommbirɗe limtorɗe (user1, user2, ...), yoppita natal mum, tee winndita yettagol @username (e galle requested-by / assigned-by) nder loowdi kartal e yowre. Fiilde yaltinaande ndee jogotaako innde goonga kuutoro. Helmere "kuutoro" jokkat ɗemngal neɗɗo yaltinoowo. E goowangol ɗum dartii.
disable-activities-description: So hurminaama, naatanɗe caɛirgol golle mooftataake tee kollirtaake nokku kala (palal sera alluwal e tab golle kartal). Alaa aslol ko moy waɗi ko. E goowangol ɗum dartii.
disable-notifications-description: So hurminaama, WeKan neldataa tintine reenagol (nder jaaɓnirgal, iimeel walla carworɗe goɗɗe) ngam golle kala. Golle ina mbaawi mooftaade tawo (so ɗe kadi ndartinaaka dow); tintine tan ɗe ndartinaama. E goowangol ɗum dartii.
disable-watch-description: So hurminaama, baawɗe reenagol dartinte — kuutorooɓe mbaawaa linde alluuje, doggi walla karte ngam heɓde tintine, tee etagol waylude tolno reenagol kala saletee. E goowangol ɗum dartii.
backup-description: Danndit ceŋaaɗi, nate kuutorooɓe e/walla Keɓe (renndorɗe binndol fof ɗe wonaa ceŋaaɗi walla nate kuutorooɓe). .zip ndee dirtintee bec to mooftorde cuɓaande — alaa fiilde sahaa — hono backup/YYYY/MM/DD/HH_MM_SS/backup.zip, jogiinde YYYY_MM_DD-HH_MM_SS/attachments, /avatars e /data. Mooftorɗe duule (S3/MinIO, Azure, GCS) kuutortoo keɓe ceŋagol teeltaaɗe e tabɗe mooftorde mum.
backup-scope-description: Instaas oo fof, walla Fedde mawnde wootere. Dannditol Fedde mawnde jogii alluuje mum e ko woni e majje fof, e ceŋaaɗi alluuje ɗee — kono alaa konte kuutorooɓe walla teelte instaas, sabu ɗe lollintee e kala Fedde mawnde. Ruttindol dannditol Fedde mawnde winndata tan e alluuje ɗe Fedde mawnde ndee jeyi.
continuous-backup-description: Neldat bayle kala e ruttorde keɓe, ceŋaaɗi, nate kuutorooɓe e loge to runngere nder majaali seeɗa, ngam waawde ruttinde e sahaa kala. Ina dogida e dannditol teeltaangol e sahaa, ngol waɗata mooftorɗe timmuɗe.
continuous-backup-enabled: Hurmin dannditol tawa dartataako e ndee sarworde
continuous-backup-target: Runngere tiindorde (laawol timmungol, e diske goɗɗo, mooftorde lollinaande e laylaytol walla ceŋorde rclone)
continuous-backup-engine-sqlite: Kelle SQLite (kelle baylaaɗe caggal dumunna kala)
continuous-backup-engine-litestream: Litestream (topirde nde a aafata so a yiɗii)
continuous-backup-engine-none: Alaa motoor ruttorde keɓe baawɗo dogde e ndee sarworde
continuous-backup-base-every: Dannditol aslol kesol caggal dumunna kala (waktuji)
continuous-backup-encrypt: Waylu dannditol ngol e kod suturo (AES-256-GCM)
continuous-backup-key-file: Fiilde omtirgal kod suturo (laawol timmungol, boowol runngere tiindorde; maantore 64 e sistem limgal 16 walla konngol suturo jogingol ko famɗi maantore 16). Mooftu kopii: tawa alaa ngal omtirgal, dannditol ngol waawaa ruttineede.
continuous-backup-upload-none: Hoto neldu to nokkuure hay goote (runngere tiindorde tan)
continuous-backup-restore-sqlite: Fiilde ruttorde keɓe SQLite (mahetee sara dannditol ngol; lommbataa fiilde kuutorteende jooni hay sahaa gooto)
continuous-backup-apply-on-restart: Faw ruttorde keɓe SQLite waɗtaande e nokkuure mum so hurmitinal aroowal waɗii (ruttorde keɓe hiiɗnde nde lomtata ina mooftaa)
continuous-backup-restore-confirm: Ruttin fedde dannditole suɓaande ndee e sahaa suɓaaɗo oo? Dannditol tawa dartataako maa dartin seeɗa tuma nde ruttindol ngol woni e dogde.
backup-restore-select-first: Suɓo dannditol iwde e doggol ngol tawo.
backup-restore-confirm: Ruttin dannditol cuɓaangol ngol? Ceŋaaɗi/nate kuutorooɓe maa winnde to fiilde-sistem tee keɓe to ruttorde keɓe e mbaydi cuɓaandi ndee.
gcs-key-filename-description: So a yiɗii: laawol to fiilde kelal JSON konte carwol e sarworde ndee.
gcs-credentials-description: So a yiɗii: ɗakku kelal JSON konte carwol. Accu ɓolum ngam huutoraade fiilde kelal walla keɓe ceŋagol goowɗe.
gcs-permissions-note: Hokku konte carwol WeKan yamiroore taro/winndugol to bucket: Google Cloud Console → Cloud Storage → Buckets → bucket maa → Permissions → Grant access. E "New principals", ɗakku iimeel konte carwol — kiisol "client_email" iwde e kelal JSON maa — kisa suɓo darɗe "Storage Object Admin" tee Mooftu.
cloud-secret-keep-blank: Accu ɓolum ngam mooftude kiisol gonɗol ngol.
gcs-bucket-description: Innde bucket Cloud Storage ɗo piille mooftetee.
s3-endpoint-menu-path: AWS: accu ɓolum (huutortoo joopirde diiwaan). S3-jaaɗduɗo: URL Endpoint iwde e konsol MinIO / Cloudflare R2 / Backblaze B2 / Wasabi / DigitalOcean Spaces maa.
s3-region-menu-path: AWS Console → S3 → Buckets → bucket maa → Properties → AWS Region.
s3-bucket-menu-path: AWS Console → S3 → Buckets → innde bucket maa (walla Create bucket → Bucket name).
s3-access-key-menu-path: AWS Console → IAM → Users → kuutoro maa → Security credentials → Access keys → Create access key → suɓo kuutoragol 'Application running outside AWS' → Create access key. Hollirtee hono 'Access key ID'.
s3-secret-key-menu-path: Yaynirde wootere e Access key ID; 'Secret access key' hollirtee gootel tan nde kelal ngal sosetee — natto ngol kisa (walla Download .csv).
azure-account-name-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → konte maa → innde nde hollirtee dow (kadi les Security + networking → Access keys → Storage account name).
azure-account-key-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → konte maa → Security + networking → Access keys → key1 → Show → Key.
azure-connection-string-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → konte maa → Security + networking → Access keys → key1 → Connection string → Show.
azure-container-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → konte maa → Data storage → Containers → jaggirgal maa (walla + Container ngam sosde gootol).
gcs-project-id-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → cuɓirgal eɓɓoore dow → ID eɓɓoore maa (Cloud overview → Dashboard → Project info → Project ID).
gcs-bucket-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → Cloud Storage → Buckets → innde bucket maa (walla Create ngam sosde gootol).
gcs-key-filename-menu-path: Laawol e sarworde WeKan to fiilde kelal JSON konte carwol aawtaande (sosaande les). Huutoro ndee WALLA ɗakku JSON nder gallal les.
gcs-credentials-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → IAM & Admin → Service accounts → konte carwol maa → Keys → Add key → Create new key → JSON → Create (aawtata fiilde ndee). Ɗakku loowdi mum ɗoo, walla mooftu fiilde ndee tee suɓo laawol mum dow.
attachment-move-storage-azure: Dirtin ceŋaagal to Azure Blob Storage
attachment-move-storage-gcs: Dirtin ceŋaagal to Google Cloud Storage
gridfs-enabled-description: Huutoro MongoDB GridFS ngam mooftugol piille
migration-stop-confirm: A yenanaa a yiɗii haɓtude eggitine fof?
gridfs-move-collectionfs-note: Ngam ceŋaaɗi e nate kuutorooɓe njiyto, dirtin ɗe iwde e CollectionFS to Mooftorde woɗnde kala.
s3-access-key-description: Kelal naatgol AWS S3 ngam goongɗitingol
s3-bucket-description: Innde baagel S3 ngam mooftude fiilde
s3-enabled-description: Huutoro AWS S3 walla MinIO ngam mooftugol piille
s3-endpoint-description: URL ñiiɓirde S3 (yeru, s3.amazonaws.com walla minio.example.com)
s3-secret-key-description: Kelal suturo AWS S3 ngam goongɗitingol
writable-path-description: Laawol fuɗɗoode deftere ngam mooftugol piille

blockly-TEXT_JOIN_TOOLTIP: Sos feccere binndi rewrude e renndingol kala limre huunde.
blockly-TEXT_LENGTH_TOOLTIP: Ina artira limre alkule (e ɓolɗe naatnaaɗe) e binndi addaaɗi ɗii.
blockly-TEXT_PRINT_TOOLTIP: Muulnu binndi, limre walla keɓal goɗngal tabitinaangal.
blockly-TEXT_REPLACE_TOOLTIP: Lomtin kala feeñgol binndi nder binndi goɗɗi.
blockly-TEXT_REVERSE_TOOLTIP: Ina waylita doosgol alkule e binndi ɗii.
blockly-TEXT_TRIM_TOOLTIP: Artir natto binndi ɗii tawa ɓolɗe ittaama e kombi gootol walla ɗiɗi.
blockly-VARIABLES_SET_TOOLTIP: Ina teela waylotoonde nde ngam fotde e naatgol ngol.
blockly-VARIABLE_ALREADY_EXISTS_FOR_ANOT: Waylotoonde innaande '%1' ina woodi tawo wonande mbaydi goɗndi: '%2'.
blockly-VARIABLE_ALREADY_EXISTS_FOR_A_PA: Waylotoonde innaande '%1' ina woodi tawo no keɓal naatnaangal e gollirde '%2'.
blockly-WORKSPACE_CONTENTS_BLOCKS_ONE: Tiggu bulokuuji gootu%2 e nokku golle.
blockly-WORKSPACE_SEARCH_INPUT_LABEL: Yiylo e nokku golle. Ñoƴƴu Enter ngam fotondiral garoowal, Shift+Enter ngam fotondiral ɓennungal. Ñoƴƴu Escape ngam uddude yiylo tee fewnude e fotondiral jooni.
r-blocks-help: Jokkondir dartinoowo gooto e gollal gootal. Daas bulokuuji iwde e boornde kuutorɗe. Huutoro taƴtorde fomiyeer ngam cuɓaaɗe ɓurɗe yaajde.
r-blocks-unavailable: Keɓe sariya ngal ngalaa. Huutoro taƴtorde fomiyeer ngam ƴeewtaade sariya ngal.
r-blocks-invalid: Jokkondir dartinoowo gooto tan e gollal gootal. Ittu bulokuuji ceertuɗi walla ɓurɗi hade reenude.
r-blocks-conflict: Sariya ngal waylaama tuma a taƴtotonoo. Loowto sariya reenaangal ngal hade reenude.
r-blocks-permission: Yamiroore jiiloowo alluwal ina waɗi ngam taƴtude sariyaaji.
scrum-releases-select-help: Kartal ina waawi wonde e yaltine keewɗe. Jogo Ctrl (Cmd e Mac) ngam suɓaade ko ɓuri gootal; laaɓtin ɗe fof ngam ittude kartal ngal e kala yaltinol.
scrum-select-sprint: Suɓo sprint ngam yiyde jaŋtol mum.
scrum-backlog-help: Doos golle e darnde doggol golle. Halfin karte e sprint feewnaaɗo walla gollotooɗo.
scrum-report-help: Jaŋte ina ndeena kiisaaji iwde e nate sprint. Kiisaaji ɗi anndaaka ina limee keeriɗi; ɗi wonaa kiisaaji meere. Fotondir yaawre tan hakkunde ngootiije kiisol e sariyaaji fotondirɗi.
scrum-confirm-close: Uddu sprint oo tee reen njeñtudi mum? Karte ɗe timmaani ina njaha e nokku cuɓaaɗo.
scrum-confirm-cancel: Haaytu sprint oo? Karte mum ina ndeena tergaagal mum haa ɗe kalfinee kadi.
scrum-partial-report: Jaŋtol feccungol: ko karte ɗe kalfinaa-ɗaa jooni tan naatnaa.
scrum-partial-snapshot: Sprint oo ina jogii tan feccere natal aranal ngal.
scrum-history-job-running: Ruttinde bayle mawɗe walla waɗtude ɗe: __done__ e gorol aslol __total__
scrum-history-job-failed: Ruttinde bayle mawɗe walla waɗtude ɗe dartii. Ɓoɗɗu ruttin walla waɗtu kadi ngam jokkude:
scrum-daily-observations-help: Kala palal ina hollira ƴeewtaare aranere winndaande e ñalnde UTC, e sahaa hollitaaɗo. Ñalɗi majjuɗi ittaama. Ƴeewtaaɗe ɗee mbinndataa kala waylo walla kolla denndaaje timmoode ñalnde. Kiisaaji ɗi anndaaka wonaa meere. Huutoro gollal Yaltin pecce ndee ngam ƴeewtaaɗe ñalnde; gollal Yaltin palal kuutorɗe ina yaltina njeñtudi sprint.
scrum-daily-truncated: Ko ƴeewtaaɗe 366 ɓurɗe hesɗude tan hollitaa.
scrum-daily-empty: Alaa ƴeewtaaɗe ñalnde winndaaɗe wonande sprint oo.
scrum-scope-history: Golle fof e golle keddiiɗe, bayle gootel gootel
scrum-scope-history-help: Sositaama e Aslol alluwal ngal gila sprint oo fuɗɗii: gorol gootol e kala baylugol karte sprint oo, jate walla golle timmuɗe.
scrum-scope-history-inconsistent: Aslol ngol sositataa natal darja sprint oo mooftaaɗo: won e bayle waɗaama tawa winndaaka e Aslol, ɗum waɗi limooje ɗee timmaani.
scrum-scope-history-truncated: Bayle adanɗe tan mbaawi janŋeede; sositagol ngol timmaani.
scrum-scope-history-empty: Alaa bayle gila sprint oo fuɗɗii.
scrum-scope-cause-scrum: Karte gonɗe e sprint oo waylaama
scrum-daily-observations-export-help: Ƴeewtaare aranere winndaande e kala ñalnde UTC; ñalɗi majjuɗi ittaama. Ƴeewtaaɗe mbinndataa kala waylo walla denndaaje timmoode ñalnde. Kiisaaji ɗi anndaaka wonaa meere.
scrum-import-pending: Naatnugol Scrum timmaani. Taƴtagol Scrum e yaltingol jaŋte ngalaa.
scrum-import-recovery-hint: Naatnugol ngol fuɗɗitaade dartini waawi timmineede ɗoo caggal dartugol mum. So eɓɓo mum mooftaaka fow, ngol waawi firteede tan; ɗum waylataa hay huunde e alluwal ngal.
scrum-import-into-board: Naatnu feewnugol Scrum e alluwal ngal
scrum-import-into-board-hint: Suɓo yaltingol alluwal WeKan walla fiilde dirtingol Scrum. Sprints e yaltine ɗe alluwal ngal jogii tawo ina jokkondira, ɗi ɗiɗitinataake abada. Karte ina fotondira e ID, walla e limre kartal e innde; karte ɗe fotondiraani ina mbinndaa tee ina njoppee no ngonnoo. Yiy tawo ngam anndude ko waylotoo.
scrum-import-preview-sprints: Sprints: __created__ kesɗi, __matched__ ɗi ngoni e alluwal ngal tawo, __skipped__ naatnaaka
scrum-import-preview-releases: Yaltine: __created__ kesɗe, __matched__ ɗe ngoni e alluwal ngal tawo, __skipped__ naatnaaka
scrum-import-preview-nothing: Alaa ko waylotoo: alluwal ngal ina jogii feewnugol ngol tawo.
scrum-import-into-board-done: Feewnugol Scrum naatnaama tee winndaama e Taariik.
scrum-import-card-ambiguous: Kartal ina fotondira e ko ɓuri kartal gootal e alluwal ngal: __reference__
scrum-import-card-on-another-board: Kartal ina jeyaa e alluwal goɗngal tee yoppaama no wonnoo: __reference__
scrum-import-record-ambiguous: Sprint walla yaltinol ina fotondira e ko ɓuri gootal e alluwal ngal: __reference__
scrum-import-record-not-imported: Sprint, yaltinol walla kewu waawaa naatneede: __reference__
sync-conflict-hint: Suɓo keɓal wonande kala luure. Fotondingol ina eto kadi caggal kala suɓagol. Hay huunde neldataake e njuɓɓudi iwdi.
sync-conflict-refresh: Dogin fotondingol kadi ngam ƴeewtaade keɓe jooni.
sync-conflict-review-complete: Karte ɗe kalfinaa-ɗaa ƴeewtaama. Alaa luure galle heddiiɗe. Fotondingol doggol timmungol doggitaaka.
sync-conflict-detach: Jogit ɗiɗitinaangal ngal no kartal nokku
sync-conflict-detach-hint: Ittu tan jokkondirgol fotondingol ɗiɗitinaangal ngal. Ko woni e mum ina heddoo e WeKan.
sync-conflict-archive: Egginde e mooftirde haɗaama sabu karte pamare gollotooɗe
sync-conflict-archive-hint: Huunde iwdi ndee majjii, kono karte pamare gollotooɗe ina kaɗa egginde e mooftirde. Jogit kartal ngal e nokku rewrude e ittude jokkondirgol fotondingol mum. Karte pamare waylataake.
sync-conflict-creation-hint: Jogit kartal ɓennungal no wonnoo tee sos kartal fotondingol kesal e doggol ngol. Etooje kadi ina kuutora lomtotoongal ngal.
sync-preview-saved: Ina tuugnii e teelte reenaaɗe. Fotondin jooni ina ƴetta tee ina ƴeewta iwdi ndee kadi.
sync-preview-unavailable: Reen iwdi fotondingol hade ɗaɓɓude yiyde tawo.
sync-preview-blocked: Ñaaw luure les ɗee hade ƴeewtaade feewnugol bayle.
sync-preview-scope: Limooje ina njowitii e galle iwdi laaɓtinaaɗe. Keɓe goɗɗe ina mbaawi diweede e janngoowo iwdi.
sync-source-heading: Galle iwdi ɗe nattaaka e ko aaɓnaa
sync-source-scope: Laabi ina ndennda feeñɗe galle e huunde iwdi fof. Huunde ndee jokkondiraaka ina wiyee e ndenndaangal mum; keɓe mum kollitaake.
sync-source-converted: Waylaama e binndi walla mbaydi goɗndi
sync-source-truncated: Jaŋtol ngol ina keertinaa e laabi 100 e inɗe galle raɓɓinaaɗe.
sync-report-retention: Dogle 20 sakkitiiɗe. Jaŋte ina ndeenee ñalɗi 30.
sync-report-partial: Dogle wooruɗe walla ɗe timmaani ina mbaawi waylude karte goɗɗe. Jaŋte ɗee njokkataa walla pirtataa dogle.
sync-report-unfinished: Ina yahra walla taƴaama; njeñtudi winndaaka
sync-report-failed: Woorii; bayle feccuɗe ina mbaawi wonde
sync-report-completed-with-warnings: Timmii e galle diwaaɗe walla waylaaɗe
sync-report-unavailable: Jaŋte dogle ina ɗaɓɓi naatgol winndugol doggol timmungol e sarworde woodnde.
sync-recovery-description: Jaŋte fotondingol reenaaɗe ñalɗi 30 sakkitiiɗi. Yiylo e ID alluwal walla doggol. Njeñtudi ndi timmaani ina waawi wonde ina yahra walla taƴaama. Hesɗitin ngam ƴeewtaade kadi; jaŋte ɗee mbaawaa jokkude walla firtude bayle.
sync-recovery-unavailable: Waawaa janngude ƴeewndo fotondingol. Ƴeewto naatgol jiiloowo e woodgol sarworde.
sync-estimate-field-hint: Suɓo gallol limle jogiingol ID gallol Jira e ngootiire kiisol, no naatnugol Jira jokkondiraangol sosiri ɗum. Bayle nokku ina ƴeewtee no luure. Keɓe iwdi majjuɗe ina njoppee; null laaɓtungal ina laaɓtina keɓal jokkondiraangal ngal.
sync-estimate-field-gitlab-hint: Teddeendi walla jate waktu GitLab winndetee e gallol limooje ngol cuɓi-ɗaa. Bayle ɗoo ƴeewtortee hono ceerondire; so fiyaaku alaa teddeendi, ki ittay kiisol jokkondiraangol.
email-recovery-description: Gorol gootol e kala keɓoowo. Yiylo huutoraade ID kuutoro. Loowdi ɓatakuuje e galleeji iimeel keɓoowo kolliraaka. Dartingol ina joga ɓatakuuje goodɗe e garooje; jokkugol ina eta neldude ɓatakuuje e doggol sabbunde jooni. Haaytugol ina momta ɓatakuuje naatnaaɗe e doggol sabbunde haa waktu ɗaɓɓitannde. So neldagol ina jokka, eto kadi caggal waktu seeɗa. Ɓatakuru nde neldagol mum fuɗɗiima waawaa artireede, tee neldagol ngol humpito mum laaɓaani ina waawi waɗeede kadi. Juume duumiiɗe e ɓatakuuje ɗe keerol etagol mum hewii ina keddoo ngam ƴeewteede. Etagol neldude ɓatakuuje ɗe neldagol mum woorii ina fuɗɗina daawal etagol kesol tee ina reena dartingol goodngol.
email-recovery-retrying: Ɓatakuuje ɗe neldagol mum ina ete kadi
email-recovery-pending: Ina sabbii walla ina eta kadi
email-recovery-empty: Alaa ɓatakuuje e doggol sabbunde walla keɓooɓe ɓe neldagol mum dartinaa.
email-recovery-unavailable: Waawaa janngude doggol iimeel. Ƴeewto yamirooje jiiloowo e heɓaare sarworde.
email-recovery-busy: Neldagol walla golle goɗɗe doggol ngol ina njokka. Hesɗitin tee eto kadi caggal waktu seeɗa.
email-recovery-failed: Golle ɗee mbaawaaka teeŋtineede. Hesɗitin doggol ngol tee eto golle ɗee kadi so ina waɗi haaju.
email-recovery-superseded: Golle kuutoro ɓurɗe hesɗude lomtinii ɗaɓɓitannde ndee. Ngonka doggol ngol jooni ina holliree.
email-recovery-confirm-cancel: Haaytude ɓatakuuje fof wonɗe jooni e doggol sabbunde ngam keɓoowo oo? Loowdi mum maa momte tee waawaa artireede. Ɓatakuuje kese sosaaɗe caggal ɗaɓɓitannde ndee ina ndanndee.
email-recovery-retry: Eto neldude kadi ɓatakuuje ɗe neldagol mum woorii
email-failure-recipient-unavailable: Jaɓoowo alaa walla konte mum daaƴaama
email-failure-delivery-unconfirmed: Yottingol waawaa teeŋtineede; ƴeewto hade etaade kadi
sync-time-estimate-hint: Kiisaaji sahaa ina kuutora galle limle sahaa aranol/heddiiɗo ɗe naatnugol Jira sosi. Gallol gootol tan fotondirngol foti woodde e alluwal ngal. Taƴtooji nokku ina ƴeewtee no luure; keɓe iwdi majjuɗe ina njoppee tee null laaɓtungal ina laaɓtina keɓal ngal.
sync-planning-hint: Sprint e yaltine ina fotondinee tan tuma Scrum hurminaa e alluwal ngal. Sprint walla yaltinol majjungol ina sosee e alluwal ngal, e ñalɗi ɗi iwdi addi; gonɗo tawo ina fotondinee e ID iwdi mum tawo, refti e innde. Bayle feewnugol nokku ina heddoo haa iwdi wayla feewnugol caɗeele ndee, tee fotondingol aranol momtataa feewnugol abada.
activity-recovery-description: Tintine ɗe timmaani ina etee kadi e hoore mum. Ƴeewto golle majjuɗe walla waylaaɗe hade etaade kadi. Etaade kadi sosataa gollal kadi abada.
activity-recovery-busy: Golloowo goɗɗo ina huuwa e tintinol ngol. Hesɗitin tee eto kadi.
activity-recovery-denied: Naatgol jaɓoowo walla cuɓaaɗe tintine mum ngalaa yamirde yottingol kadi.
activity-recovery-source-unavailable: Gollal aranal ngal majjii walla waylaama. Hay huunde sosaaka kadi.
activity-recovery-failed: Waawaa timminde yottingol tintinol. Golle fadiiɗe ndeenaama.
activity-recovery-control-conflict: Tintinol ngol waylaama gila ngol looweede. Ƴeewto ngonka kesɗitinaaɗo hade etaade kadi.
activity-recovery-control-failed: Waawaa teeŋtinde teeltol yottingol. Hesɗitin tee ƴeewto ngonka mum jooni.
activity-recovery-cancel-confirm: Haaytu haa abada yottingol heddiingol wonande gollal ngal? Ɗum waawaa jokkeede. Iimeel naatnaaɗo e dogordu e tintine yottinaaɗe noddataake.
rule-email-recovery-description: Ƴeewto etagol neldude iimeeluuji sarɗiiji ngol winndaama. Etagol ngol tabbitinaaka ena waawi wonde e neldude haa jooni walla dartinaama. Ciimtol ngol neldataa goɗngol, dartintaa kadi neldude.
rule-email-recovery-empty: Alaa etagol neldude iimeeluuji sarɗiiji ngol yahdi e ɗaɓɓitaare ndee.
rule-email-recovery-unavailable: Waawaa loowde etooje iimeel sariya. Hesɗitin ngam etaade kadi.
rule-email-recovery-actions-hint: WeKan neldataa iimeel mo tabbitinaaka goɗngol e hoore mum hay sahaa. Neldude goɗngol yahata ko to heɓooɓe ɓe tabbitinaaka tan. Maanto ɗum no neldaaɗo so a anndii wonde ɗum hewtii, walla woppu ɗum.
rule-email-recovery-wait: Neldude arande ndee ina waawi wonde haa jooni ina jokka. A waawi waɗde kuugal caggal __time__.
rule-email-recovery-resend: Neldu goɗngol to heɓooɓe ɓe tabbitinaaka
rule-email-recovery-resend-confirm: Neldude oo iimeel goɗngol to heɓooɓe ɓe tabbitinaaka? Kala mo sarworde iimeel mum jaɓi ɗum tawa humpitinaani WeKan maa heɓ ɗum laabi ɗiɗi.
rule-email-recovery-mark-sent-confirm: Maantude oo iimeel no neldaaɗo to kala neɗɗo? Waɗ ɗum tan so a anndii wonde ɗum hewtii.
rule-email-recovery-drop-confirm: Woppude oo iimeel? Ɗum neldetaake to heɓooɓe ɓe tabbitinaaka.
rule-email-resolution-too-early: Neldude arande ndee ina waawi wonde haa jooni ina jokka. Eto goɗngol caggal ɗum.
rule-email-resolution-resend-in-flight: Neldude goɗngol fuɗɗinoonde ina waawi wonde haa jooni ina jokka. Eto goɗngol caggal ɗum.
rule-email-resolution-nothing-to-resend: Heɓooɓe fof tabbitinaama kisa. Maanto ɗum no neldaaɗo e nokku mum.
rule-email-resolution-resend-uncertain: Sarworde iimeel ndee jaabaaki. Ko neldaa goɗngol ina waawi hewtaade walla hewtaaki; ɗum holliraa no jokkude.
rule-email-resolution-busy: Jiiloowo goɗɗo ina feewna haala oo iimeel. Eto goɗngol caggal seeɗa.
rule-email-resolution-command-changed: Iimeel danndaaɗo oo nanndataa e ngal etagol jooni, ɗum waɗi a waawaa feewnude ɗum ɗoo.
rule-email-resolution-attempt-invalid: Binndol danndaaɗol ngal etagol moƴƴaani, ɗum waɗi a waawaa feewnude ɗum ɗoo.
rule-email-resolution-failed: Haala oo iimeel waawaaka feewneede. Kesɗitin kisa eto goɗngol.
rule-email-legacy-description: Ɗee iimeeluuji kuule ko yamre WeKan ɓooynde hebilnoo ɗi, kono winndaali ɗo loowdi majji iwri. Ɗum waɗi WeKan neldataa ɗi e hoore mum. Ƴeewto so winnduɗo kuulal ngal ina jogii haa jooni yamiroore naatde, kisa jokkondir ɗum goɗngol ngam hebilude ɗum kadi iwde e kartal ngal no woniri jooni, walla woppu ɗum.
rule-email-legacy-reason-details-snapsho: Cariiɗe kartal iwɗe e yamre ɓooynde
rule-email-legacy-rebind-confirm: Hebilude oo iimeel goɗngol iwde e kartal ngal no woniri jooni? Loowdi mum ina waawi seertude e ko hebilnoo ko adii.
rule-email-legacy-discard-confirm: Woppude oo iimeel? Ɗum neldetaake hay sahaa.
rule-email-legacy-unavailable: Iimeeluuji kuule cabbiiɗi ƴeewtagol mbaawaaka looweede. Kesɗitin ngam etaade goɗngol.
rule-email-legacy-access-denied: Winnduɗo kuulal ngal jogaaki yamiroore naatde e ngal kartal jooni, walla kuulal ngal waylaama, ɗum waɗi jokkondirde ɗum goɗngol waawaa. A waawi woppude ɗum.
rule-email-legacy-source-changed: Gollal puɗɗinangal oo iimeel waylaama, ɗum waɗi jokkondirde ɗum goɗngol waawaa. A waawi woppude ɗum.
rule-email-legacy-source-unavailable: Kartal ngal oo iimeel iwri heɓotaako jooni, ɗum waɗi jokkondirde ɗum goɗngol waawaa. A waawi woppude ɗum.
rule-email-legacy-plan-unavailable: Gollugol kuulal ngal hebilnoo oo iimeel danndaaka jooni, ɗum waɗi jokkondirde ɗum goɗngol waawaa. A waawi woppude ɗum.
rule-email-legacy-attempt-exists: Oo iimeel neldaama kisa, walla neldude mum etaama, walla ɗum woppaama.
rule-email-legacy-failed: Ngal baɗal waawaaka timmineede. Kesɗitin kisa eto goɗngol.
stuck-sync-operation-heading: Golle fotondingol doggol ɗe mbaawaa fillitde
stuck-sync-operation-description: Kala e golle fotondingol doggol reenaaɗe ɗee darii e hakkunde tee waawaa timmineede kadi, sabu doggol mum ittaama, sosaa kadi walla teelaa kadi, walla kuutoro fuɗɗiiɗo ɗum majjii naatgol winndugol. Tuma gootal ina fadi, doggol ngol waawaa fotondineede. Woppu ɗum ngam yamirde doggol ngol fotondineede kadi: bayle ɗe waɗaa tawo ina keddoo, bayle reenaaɗe heddiiɗe mbinndataake abada, tee fotondingol garoowol ina fotondira doggol ngol e iwdi mum kadi.
stuck-sync-operation-reason-scope-change: Doggol ngol ittaama, sosaa kadi walla teelte fotondingol mum waylaama
stuck-sync-operation-reason-access-denie: Kuutoro fuɗɗiiɗo ɗum alaa kadi naatgol winndugol e doggol ngol fof
stuck-sync-operation-reason-trigger-unkn: Reenaama e yamre WeKan ɓennunde tawa ko fuɗɗini ɗum alaa
stuck-sync-operation-replayable-now: Ina waawi fillitteede jooni tee ina timmina e hoore mum, ɗum noon waawaa woppeede.
stuck-sync-operation-discard-confirm: Woppu gollal fotondingol doggol reenaangal ngal? Bayle ɗe ngal waɗi tawo ina keddoo; ko heddii winndataake abada. Doggol ngol ina waawi fotondineede kadi caggal ɗum.
stuck-sync-operation-empty: Alaa golle fotondingol doggol fadiiɗe ƴeewtagol.
stuck-sync-operation-truncated: Ko 50 ɓurɗe ɓooyde tan hollitaa. Woppu goɗɗe tee hesɗitin ngam yiyde goɗɗe.
stuck-sync-operation-unavailable: Waawaa loowde golle fotondingol doggol. Hesɗitin ngam etaade kadi.
stuck-sync-operation-not-stuck: Gollal ngal yiytaaka no dariiɗo, ɗum noon waawaa woppeede.
stuck-sync-operation-replayable: Gollal ngal ina waawi fillitteede jooni tee ina timmina e hoore mum, ɗum noon woppaaka.
stuck-sync-operation-busy: Doggol ngol ina fotondinee jooni. Eto kadi e sahaa seeɗa.
stuck-sync-operation-failed: Ngal baɗal waawaaka timmineede. Kesɗitin kisa eto goɗngol.
interrupted-import-description: Kala e naatnuuji alluwal ɗii darii e hakkunde - sarworde ndee fuɗɗitii, walla naatnugol ngol woorii - tee yoppi alluwal feccungal. Naatnugol waawaa jokkeede, sabu fiilde iwdi mum reenaaka. Jogit alluwal ngal no wonirnoo, walla woppu ngal tee naatnu fiilde ndee kadi. Woppugol ina momta alluwal ngal naatnugol ngol sosi e kala ko woni e mum, e kala ko ɓeydaa e mum gila ɗum.
interrupted-import-state-discarding: Ina woppee; woppu kadi ngam timminde
interrupted-import-scrum: Daraja Scrum mum ina jogii tobbere reenaande mum (__state__, __next__ e __total__ taƴe). So a jogitii alluwal ngal, timmin walla woppu ɗum e artirgol naatnugol Scrum alluwal ngal.
interrupted-import-counts: laabi __swimlanes__, doggi __lists__, karte __cards__, doggi ƴeewndagol __checklists__, yowe __comments__, ceŋaaɗi __attachments__
interrupted-import-keep-confirm: Jogit alluwal feccungal ngal no wonirngal? Hay huunde ittaaka, tee naatnugol ngol winndetaake ɗoo kadi.
interrupted-import-discard-confirm: Woppu naatnugol ngol? Alluwal ngal ngol sosi e kala ko woni e mum ina momte haa abada.
interrupted-import-empty: Alaa naatnuuji alluuje taƴaaɗi fadiiɗi ƴeewtagol.
interrupted-import-truncated: Ko 50 ɓurɗi ɓooyde tan hollitaa. Jogit walla woppu goɗɗi tee hesɗitin ngam yiyde goɗɗi.
interrupted-import-unavailable: Waawaa loowde naatnuuji alluuje taƴaaɗi. Hesɗitin ngam etaade kadi.
interrupted-import-foreign-board: Alluwal jogiingal id ngal sosaaka e naatnugol ngol, ɗum noon meemaaka.
interrupted-import-scrum-busy: Daraja Scrum mum ina winndee walla ina artiree tawo. Eto kadi caggal majaango seeɗa.
interrupted-import-failed: Ngal baɗal waawaaka timmineede. Kesɗitin kisa eto goɗngol.
saml-login-not-started: Ngal ceŋagol SAML fuɗɗaaka e ndee tabbirde wanngorde. Tiiɗno, seŋo kadi.
history-request-pending-undo: Sarworde ndee tabbitinaani ɗimmitgol maa cakkitiingol tawo.
history-request-pending-redo: Sarworde ndee tabbitinaani waɗtugol maa cakkitiingol tawo.
history-request-hint: So a ƴeewtii kadi, ko ñaagol ngol gootol neldete kadi, ɗum waɗi ngal waawaa ɗimminde baylugol ɗiɗaɓol hay sahaa.
scrum-history-checkpoint-stuck: Firtugol, waɗtugol walla artirgol bayle Scrum darii e luure. Taƴtooji Scrum e alluwal ngal ina kaɗaa haa ɗum ñaawee.
scrum-history-checkpoint-counts: Bayle __applied__ e __total__ mbinndaama, __pending__ mbinndaaka, tee __conflicted__ waylaama e neɗɗo goɗɗo gila ɗum.
scrum-history-checkpoint-hint: Rutto caggal ina artira kala winndannde waylaande no wonnoo ko adii; ina hokkee tan so hay gooto waylaani winndanɗe ɗee gila ɗum. Jogitde alluwal ngal no wonirngal ina itta gollal dariingal tawa hay winndannde waylaaka. E laabi ɗiɗi ɗii fof, ɗum ina winndee e Panel Jiiloowo, Caɗeele, Artirgol.
scrum-history-checkpoint-discard-confirm: Jogit kala winndannde no woniri jooni, e bayle ɗe gollal dariingal ngal winndi tawo?
scrum-history-checkpoint-ask-admin: Jiiloowo alluwal ina waawi rutto caggal walla jogitde alluwal ngal no wonirngal.
login-setting-clear-secret: Momtu kiisol danndangol e palanteere jiiloowo
login-setting-after-restart: Ena fuɗɗoo gollude caggal nde WeKan hurminaama kadi
login-setting-env-only: Ko taariindi sarworde tan teelata ɗee. Ina kollitee ɗoo no janngugol tan.
email-to-card-description: Iimeel neldaa ka ñiiɓirde alluwal maa wontay kartal e nder alluwal ngal.
email-to-card-webhook: URL webhook naatoowo jeyɗo iimeel (Mailgun, SendGrid, Postmark walla relais MIME mo wayliraaka)
email-to-card-secret-saved: Danndaama - acc ɗum meho ngam reende ɗum
email-to-card-sandstorm-board: Alluwal ngal iimeel neldaaɗo e grain ngal yahata
email-to-card-sandstorm-board-none: Alaa - iimeelji jogiiɗi tokeen alluwal e toɓɓere tan
email-to-card-sandstorm-subject: Waɗ ɗum e toɓɓere ngam yettaade alluwal ngal e innde maa:
email-to-card-your-address: Ñiiɓirde iimeel maa e alluwal ngal
email-to-card-address-private: Suuɗ ɗum: kala jogiiɗo ɗum waawii ɓeydude kartalji e innde maa.
email-to-card-off-admin-off: Jaɓde iimeel waɗaaka e Palanteere jiiloowo.
email-to-card-off-board-off: Jiiloowo alluwal huɓɓaani iimeel e alluwal ngal.
email-to-card-off-member-off: A ñifii ñiiɓirɗe alluwal maa e Teelte terɗe.
email-to-card-off-sandstorm-no-session: Grain ngal alaa ñiiɓirde iimeel mum tawo. Hesɗitin hello ngoo.
email-to-card-off-not-authorized: Aɗa sokli yamiroore winndude e alluwal ngal.
inbound-account-invalid: Sanduu iimeel IMAP no sokli innde sarworde moƴƴunde.
feature-views-email-desc: Alluwal ngal wa sanduku iimeel: doggol iimeel ngol ko Sanduku naatirde, doggi ɗi ko runtuɗe, maandeeji ɗi ko maandeeji, terɗe ɗe mbinndata e njaabtoo iimeel ka ñiiɓirde alluwal ngal.
email-view-not-receiving: Alluwal ngal jaɓataa iimeel tawo. Huɓɓu ɗum e teelte tintinol alluwal ngal → Iimeel faade kartal.
email-view-invalid-address: Gooto e ñiiɓirɗe ɗe wonaa ñiiɓirde iimeel moƴƴo.
email-view-too-many-recipients: Jaɓooɓe 20 ɓuri heewde e bataake kala.
email-view-too-many: Iimeelji keewɗi neldaama e waktu caggal ngu. Fuɗɗito ɓaawo.
email-view-no-list: Alluwal ngal ina sokli doggol ngam iimeel ngel.
feature-views-chat-desc: Alluwal ngal wa nokku golle haaldagol: nokkuuje golle, alluuje, laabi, doggi e karte wa leggal kanaaluuji, kartal ngal hakkunde e yowe mayre wa batakeeji haaldagol.
chat-view-pick-card: Suɓo kartal e kanaaluuji ngam yiyde ɗum ɗoo.
feature-views-column-sets-desc: Karte ɗe gooto e kawtal kolonji keewɗi innde - e timminde, adannde, faltirde walla huunde goɗɗo - dirtinaaɗe hakkunde kolonji e foddoyde.
column-sets-empty: Kawtal kolonji alaa tawo. Jiiloowo alluwal waawi waɗde gooto: inndin ngal, refti ɓeydu kolonji mum.
feature-views-version-control-desc: Alluwal hono jokkorde caɗeele GitHub walla Gitea: kartal hono caɗeele, maandeeji e tiindi, yowe hono haala, ceŋaaɗi hono fiilde, e aslol alluwal e firtude.
vcs-no-issues: Alaa caɗeere fotndiinde e ndee yiylo.
vcs-no-milestones: Alaa tiindi tawo. Maande jogiinde ñalnde sakket ko tiindi.
vcs-issue-title-too-long: Tiitoonde ndee ina juuti no feewi.
vcs-issue-body-too-long: Sifaa oo ina juuti no feewi.
vcs-no-list: Alluwal ngal alaa doggol walla laawol ngam caɗeere.
card-qr-code-desc: Yiylo ɗum ngam udditde ndee kartal e telefon walla tablet.
card-qr-code-too-long: Jokkol ndee kartal ina juuti no feewi ngam kod QR.
vcs-no-wiki: Alaa wiki tawo. Naatnugol fedde GitHub ina addita wiki mooftorde kod ɗoo.
github-org-import-desc: Mooftorde kod kala fedde walla huutoro wonta alluwal mum, udditiraaɗo e Board View / Version Control: caɗeele mum e yowe mum, maandeeji e fiilde, bayyinaaɗe mum, golle GitHub Actions mum no Kuule, e wiki mum.
github-org-import-token-hint: Ina waɗɗii ngam mooftorɗe kod suturaaɗe e keerol API ɓurngol toowde. Ina huutoree tan tuma naatnugol ngol ina yaha, ina mooftaaka abadaa.
github-org-import-issues: Caɗeele, e yowe, maandeeji e fiilde
github-org-import-owner-invalid: Winndu innde fedde walla huutoro, walla ñiiɓirde mum GitHub.
github-org-import-running: Naatnugol fedde ina yaha gila e hande.
optional-apis-desc: REST API mbaɗi no API ɗeen jokkooji goɗɗi, ngam yo jaaɓnirgal e script maɓɓe mbaawu huutoraade ndee WeKan wano backend maɓɓe: ko ɓe danndi fof danndetee e WeKan, e dow alluuje WeKan. Kala gooto ena uddi haa a maandina ɗum ɗoo. Alaa gooto e majje jogii hakkeeji mum: kalifaa ena naata e token WeKan API, ena waawi yiyde e waylude tan ko neɗɗo oo waawi yiyde e waylude e WeKan. Ɗe fof ena njiɗi WeKan REST API ena uddita (WITH_API=true). Ñiiɓirde ndee les kala gooto ko ndee kalifaa huutortoo wano sarworde mum.
optional-api-trello-desc: Jaaɓnirɗe e script winndaaɗe ngam REST API Trello (ko wayi no Trellinator) ena kuuwa e WeKan: alluuje, doggi, kartalle, maandeeji, terɗe, yowe e doggi ƴeewndo. Token Trello ko token WeKan API. Momtude kartal ena mooftoo ɗum e WeKan.
optional-api-jira-desc: Kalifaaji REST API v2 Jira ena kuuwa e WeKan: eggol ko alluwal (coktirgal mum ko coktirgal alluwal), caɗeele ko kartal (DEV-7), ngonka ko doggol, eggitagol ena dirtina kartal ngal. Yiylo ena jaɓa JQL ɓolɓolngal: project, status, assignee = currentUser(), text e ORDER BY. Naatu e token WeKan API wano finnde. Momtude caɗeele ena mooftoo ɗum.
optional-api-github-desc: Kalifaaji REST API GitHub ngam caɗeele ena kuuwa e WeKan: depo ko alluwal, caɗeele ko kartal, e maandeeji, tiindi (maandeeji jogiiɗi ñalawma timmude), yowe, e udditiiɗi walla uddiiɗi wano e Jiytol alluwal / Ñiiɓirde yamre. Token ko token WeKan API.
optional-api-gitea-desc: Kalifaaji REST API Gitea e Forgejo ngam caɗeele ena kuuwa e WeKan, no API jaaɓndi e GitHub nii: depo ko alluwal, caɗeele ko kartal. Token ko token WeKan API.
bots-none: Alaa bot tawaa. Bot ko golloowo e sarworde maa - jaŋtoowo AI, golle CI, skript - mo alluwal ngal okkata kartalle.
bot-not-found: Bot oo alaa e alluwal ngal.
bot-option-not-found: Jaabawol ngol wonaa ko bot okki.
webhook-internal-hosts-desc: Webhooks yaltuɗe waawaa yettaade ñiiɓirɗe e laylaytol WeKan e hoore mum, ngam hay gooto waawaa fewndinde webhook alluwal e golle nder. Winndu ɗoo koɓooɓe e laylaytol ngol ɓe webhooks mbaawi yettaade - Node-RED, sarwoor yeewtere - gooto e kala diidol, wano innde walla ñiiɓirde, e poor ngam yamirde poor ngoo tan. Mehe: hay gooto. Ko jiiloowe lowre ndee tan mbaawi waylude doggol ngol.
account-webhook-desc: Ñiiɓirde wootere nde WeKan humpitata so goɗɗo naatii walla konte hesere sosaama. Alaa ko neldetee haa huunde e ko woni les ɗoo maantinee. Ɗum roondii ko waɗi, Innde kuutorɗo e waktu; maantin geɗe goɗɗe tan so jaɓoowo oo no haajii ɗe.
account-webhook-field-ip: Ñiiɓirde IP nde naatgol ngol iwri
activity-recovery-cancel-older-prompt: Haaytu kala tintinol golle ndeŋol ɓooyi ko ɓuri balɗe jelu?
activity-recovery-bulk-result: Haaytaama %s, neldaama %s, %s ɓooyɓe ina ndeŋi tawo.
vcs-synced-from: Hawrinaama immorde e %s: uddit e uddu ɗoon.
vcs-synced-issue: Ndee caɗeere hawrinaama: uddit e uddu nde e jokkorgal mayre.
sync-write-back: Winndu waylooji ɗii e GitLab: tiitoonde, sifaa, miijooji, uddugol e udditgol kadi
email-bounces-description: Ko WeKan waɗata e iimeel ruttiiɗo: ñiiɓirde winndaande no feewaani, boyet heewɗo, jaabawol ko woodaani e golle, plent spam. Kala noone woodi golle mum, waɗeteeɗe so ruttike ko ɗuuɗi noon.
email-bounces-action-stop-email: Daro neldude iimeel e ñiiɓirde ndee
email-bounces-category-hard-desc: Ñiiɓirde ndee woodaani: juumre binndol, konte momtaande, domain anndaaka.
email-bounces-category-soft-desc: Yottinaaka jooni: boyet heewi, sarwor ina waɗi golle. Ko ɗuuɗi ɓadondirɗi tan firti huunde.
email-bounces-category-auto-reply-desc: Jaabawuuje ko woodaani e golle, foofaango walla sistem tiket. Iimeel o yottinaama.
email-bounces-category-complaint-desc: Jaɓoowo o maandini iimeel o wano spam.
email-bounces-ses-description: E Amazon SES, neldu tintine Bounce e Complaint, e doosgal jaɓgol ngam ñiiɓirde nde WeKan neldirta, e toɓɓere SNS, ndeen winndito ñiiɓirde ndee e mayre rewrude e HTTPS:
email-bounces-ses-topics: ARN toɓɓe SNS jaɓeteeɗe, gooto e kala diidol
email-bounces-stopped-only: Ñiiɓirɗe ɗe WeKan neldataa iimeel kadi tan
email-bounces-clear-hint: Yejjit ruttooji ñiiɓirde ndee, nelda ɗum iimeel kadi
email-bounces-providers-description: So WeKan ina nelda e carwol gooto e ɗeen, huɓɓu ngol, rokku carwol ngol ñiiɓirde webhook nde ngam huunde iimeel ruttiiɗi e plent spam, ñooƴaa ɗoo coktirgal ngol fommbinirta ɗum, walla finnde suuraande nde ngaddu-ɗaa e ñiiɓirde nde no https://user:password@… walla ?secret=…
email-bounce-provider-secret-required: Carwol huɓɓaangol ina sokli coktirgal mum fommbinirgal walla finnde mum suuraande.
activity-pub-enabled: Alluwe kala neɗɗo ina njaltina golle kartalle mum'en e fediverse (ActivityPub)
activity-pub-desc: Ko ñifaa e tolno goodngo. So hubbii, kala alluwal kala neɗɗo ina waawi reweede gila Mastodon e sarworɗe fediverse goɗɗe no @board-<id> e ñiiɓirde WeKan oo, golle kesse kartalle ɗee kadi ina njottoo rewɓe mum. Ko e janngugol tan: hay huunde nde sarworde fediverse neldata waylataa alluwal, alluwe keeriiɗe kadi njaltintaake abadaa.
caldav-sync-desc: Waɗ ñalɗi sakket kartalle alluwal ngal e haatumeere - Nextcloud Calendar walla haatumeere CalDAV kala. Ñalnde sakket nde dirtinaa e haatumeere ina rutta e kartal ngal. Huutoro finnde suuraande jaaɓnirgal, wonaa maa.
caldav-enabled: Yahdin ñalɗi sakket e haatumeere nde
caldav-invalid-url: Ñiiɓirde haatumeere ndee ina foti wonde ñiiɓirde http:// walla https://, tawa alaa innde kuutoro walla finnde suuraande e nder mum.
caldav-not-linked: Ko adii fof, mooftu ñiiɓirde haatumeere, hubbu yahdingol.
webdav-storage-description: Mooftu ceŋaaɗi e nder doosiyee e sarworde WebDAV - Nextcloud Files, ownCloud walla goɗɗo kala. Huutoro finnde suuraande jaaɓnirgal sosaande WeKan. Sarworde e laylaytol WeKan e hoore mum ina waawi huutoreede ɗoo, ko fayde e ko jiiloowo lowre tan teelata ñiiɓirde ndee.
sqrl-desc: Ko daaƴaa e ko ƴoƴaa. So a hurmini ɗum, hello seŋorde ndee hokkat SQRL, kadi terɗe ɓeydata ganndal SQRL mum'en adii e Teelte terɗe. SQRL ina sokli WeKan e ñiiɓirde https://.
sqrl-scan: Yuurno kod oo e jaaɓnirgal maa SQRL, walla uddit kuutorgal maa SQRL e kaɓirgol ngol.
sqrl-expired: Kod SQRL ngol saŋii. Fuɗɗito kadi.
sqrl-needs-https: SQRL ina sokli WeKan e ñiiɓirde https://.
sqrl-description: Seŋo e ganndal maa SQRL e nokku finnde suuraande. Ɓeydu ɗum ɗoo laabi gooti e kuutorgal maa SQRL; aɗa waawi momtude ɗum ɗoo sahaa kala.
sqrl-disabled-by-client: Seŋorde SQRL daaƴaama e ndee konte immorde e kuutorgal maa SQRL. Hurmin ɗum kadi toon e kod maa daddingol.
sqrl-only-on: Kuutorgal maa SQRL uddii ndee konte e SQRL tan: laabi goɗɗi fof ngam seŋorde ɗon salaa.
sqrl-hardlock-on: Kuutorgal maa SQRL uddii ndee konte fof: wattitgol finnde e waylugol imeel ɗon salaa.
sqrl-only: Ndee konte seŋotoo e SQRL tan.
sqrl-hardlock: Ndee konte uddaama e SQRL: waawaa artireede walla waylteede e laabi goɗɗi.
windows-sso-failed: Seŋo e Windows roŋkii. Konte maa Windows ina waawi wonde yamiraaka ɗoo.
